title: Stemming vs Lemmatization
seoDescription: Produce a rule-based stem and dictionary-backed lemma for a supplied word with deterministic fallback behavior.
description:
Compare rule-based suffix stripping (stemming) against vocabulary-backed morphological dictionary normalization (lemmatization).

Stemming uses crude syntactic heuristics, whereas lemmatization uses morphological analysis to return valid dictionary headwords.

### Mathematical Formulation
$$
\operatorname{Stem}(w) = \text{strip\_suffixes}(w), \quad \operatorname{Lemma}(w) = \text{dict\_lookup}(w, \text{POS})
$$

### Step-by-Step Implementation
1. Apply heuristic suffix stripping rules to truncate word affixes
2. Perform morphological dictionary lookup to identify canonical lemma
3. Fallback to normalized form when word is absent from lemma dictionary

### Returns
Dictionary containing 'word', 'stem', and 'lemma'.
